Now average each component: (250+0)/2=125, (235+255)/2=245, (215+255)/2=235. So new color: R=125, G=245, B=235. Convert to hex: 125 decimal = 0x7D, 245 decimal = 0xF5, 235 decimal = 0xEB. So hex: #7DF5EB. That is the average. But maybe they want to mix by blending equally. So answer: #7DF5EB. Provide explanation. Also mention that mixing equal parts yields that.
